name: capital_country
description: Recall the country associated with a national capital; matched control copies an explicitly supplied country in the same format.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('Paris','France'),('Berlin','Germany'),('Rome','Italy'),('Madrid','Spain'),('Lisbon','Portugal'),('Tokyo','Japan'),('Beijing','China'),('Ottawa','Canada'),('Canberra','Australia'),('Brasilia','Brazil'),('Cairo','Egypt'),('Nairobi','Kenya'),('Athens','Greece'),('Ankara','Turkey'),('Bangkok','Thailand'),('Hanoi','Vietnam'),('Seoul','South Korea'),('New Delhi','India'),('Oslo','Norway'),('Stockholm','Sweden'),('Helsinki','Finland'),('Warsaw','Poland'),('Vienna','Austria'),('Bern','Switzerland')]
templates=['Geography quiz: {city} is the capital of which country? Answer:','Name the country whose capital is {city}. Answer:','Capital: {city}. Country:','The national capital {city} belongs to which country? Answer:']
items=[];control=[]
for t in templates:
 for city,country in pairs:
  p=t.format(city=city)
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+country})
  control.append({'prompt':'Reference country: '+country+'. Copy the reference country to answer. '+p,'answer':' '+country})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
